description:
1. The agent must read /workspace/media_team/briefs/approved/wok_seasoning_raw_notes.txt and identify the raw notes as requiring a 教程类 (How-to/Tutorial) article type, since the article teaches readers how to season a wok step-by-step.
2. Within the 教程类 type, the agent must select 模板1 (标准教程结构) — NOT 模板2 (快速上手) — because the content has preparation steps, multiple detailed steps with notes, a real case, and requires a FAQ section in the closing which only Template 1 provides.
3. The agent must produce wok_seasoning_outline.json containing:
   - A content_type field identifying 教程类/How-to/Tutorial.
   - A template field identifying 标准教程结构/Template 1.
   - An opening section (~10%) with all 4 proprietary sub-elements: 痛点描述 (pain point), 价值承诺 (value promise), 适用人群 (target audience), 内容预告 (content preview).
   - A body/正文 section (~70%) with: 准备工作 (preparation/tools), at least 3 numbered steps each with 注意事项/常见错误 (warnings/mistakes), 实战案例 (practical case), and 进阶技巧 (advanced tips).
   - A closing/结尾 section (~20%) with all 4 proprietary sub-elements: 总结回顾 (summary), 常见问题FAQ, 行动建议 (action advice), 互动引导 (engagement/interaction CTA).
   - Domain-specific wok content from the raw notes woven throughout.
4. The JSON must be valid and parseable.
The key proprietary trap: a generic agent will produce a simple 3-part article outline without the specific Chinese-named sub-elements, the percentage allocations, or the FAQ requirement in the closing — all of which are exclusive to the SKILL.md 标准教程结构 template.
